canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What developer portfolios ship, executed impeccably.

options.label: The Chalkboard

raised.raise: Scale contrast, from the foundry: hierarchy by size contrast alone, no ornament.
Lift, not link, from the collage: sections arrive as layers rising to the top of the stack.
One full-bleed move, from the rack: the hero owns the viewport edge to edge, no boxed card.
Memory in the margins, from the reef: seen sections leave quiet traces in the rail.
Every piece numbered, from the tissue: one FIG. and callout system across all sections.

options.risk: Classroom charm can read junior to a hiring manager; the derivations must be watertight or the conceit collapses.
options.thesis: The candidate at the board: every result worked out in front of you, nothing asserted without its derivation.
options.viewport: One full-bleed slate wall: the name worked large in chalk, the three-number proof derived beside it, course-outline nav on the rail.

options.label: The Poster Session
options.risk: The most familiar strong direction: boards of pinned work are what every portfolio wants to be.
options.thesis: The interview as poster session: results pinned up, takeaway stated, author standing by.
options.viewport: Tri-fold board: takeaway box up top, pinned figures with captions, an author card with contact.

options.case: Fuses poorly: recruiters will not drag sliders to find contact info, and play buries proof.

options.case: Fuses poorly: collage energy buries skimmable proof, and angled baselines fight reading order.
options.label: The Hybrid Collage

options.case: Fuses poorly: the rack means nothing to hiring, and art-first buries facts.
options.label: The Deck Wall

options.case: Fuses poorly: text over a void with GPU wakes is hostile to skimming, and to static hosting.
options.label: The Night Sea

options.case: Fuses poorly: the tissue world is foreign to hiring, though its numbered pieces almost fit.
options.kept: Every piece numbered; notches must meet.
